title: A muxed ScAddress as a contract-data key traps
pattern: CAP-0067: a muxed ScAddress may not appear in a contract-data key. The address is valid in the arguments and even in the footprint's LedgerKey, but the put traps.

hazards.placement: muxed ScAddress inside a contract-data key: trapped

facts.says: The call fails: the host traps.
The footprint's read-write key holds the muxed address M(bob, 42).
With diagnostic events the host says why: storage error invalid_input, "muxed addresses should not be used in the storage keys".

some./event/body/v0/data/vec/0/string: muxed addresses should not be used in the storage keys
